title: events.rs: closeafter=state with LEI delivers only first replay event
description: When a client reconnects with Last-Event-ID and multiple JMAP types have advanced past the LEI, the replay_events list can hold up to 3 events. The stream is built as replay_events.chain(live_stream) and then take(1) is applied for closeafter=state. Only the first replay event is delivered; the other types are silently dropped. The client learns about only one type mismatch and must reconnect again for the others. RFC 8620 s7.3 implies all current-state events should be delivered before closing. Fix: apply take(replay_count.max(1)) or take on the live portion only.
